passages.text: Rumination syndrome is a condition in which people repeatedly and unintentionally spit up (regurgitate) undigested or partially digested food from the stomach, rechew it, and then either reswallow the food or spit it out.
rumination syndrome is a poorly understood disorder and a number of theories have speculated the mechanisms that cause the regurgitation which is a unique symptom to this disorder
Rumination disorder is a condition in which a person keeps bringing up food from the stomach into the mouth (regurgitation) and rechewing the food.

Rumination syndrome is a rare disorder seen among children and adolescents; however adults too can be affected with this disorder. In this condition the food that is consumed few hours ago is regurgitated (brought back in the mouth) and chewed either to be swallowed again or spitted out.

rumination syndrome or merycism is an under diagnosed chronic motility disorder characterized by effortless regurgitation of most meals following consumption due to the involuntary contraction of the muscles around the abdomen

reference.answer: Rumination syndrome is a condition where people repeatedly and unintentionally spit up undigested or partially digested food from the stomach, rechew it, and then either reswallow the food or spit it out. It is a rare disorder seen among children and adolescents, though adults can also be affected.
